techniques.name: Typed question carried across photographs
techniques.description: 0.00-0.57 s: pure white (#FFFFFF), a black caret and a huge grotesque word typing at about one character every 2-3 frames ('Wh' F9, 'Wha' F11, 'What' F14), centred, about 55% of frame width. Hard cut at 0.567 s to a warm overhead lifestyle photo with a white rounded search bar (about 43% wide, y 0.47, text height about 2.5% of frame) continuing the same question; at 1.333 s a second overhead photo where the question continues as two outline chips either side of the photographed phone. The question is never finished before the answer object appears.
techniques.routeReason: Typing, bar and chips are Remotion (TypedLine, typingSchedule, ui-prompt-bar); the two overhead lifestyle photographs of hands with devices are people and products in use, so they must be licensed stills or a shoot (or budgeted generated stills).

techniques.name: Match cut on a small object from photo to flat ground
techniques.description: The orb glowing on a photographed phone screen (about 5% of frame width at x 0.48, y 0.50) grows on the screen over F65-F69, then at F70 (2.333 s) the photograph is replaced by a flat dark green ground (#1D221E to #054B26) with a glossy 3D orb at the same position and size. Two small words type in either side of it from F72, so the orb becomes a word in a sentence.
techniques.routeReason: A hard cut with matched position; the glossy orb is a render (Blender or a three.js sphere) composited as a still or short sequence.

techniques.name: Inline object grows to become the ground, then mark to wordmark
techniques.description: The flanking words fade in 1-2 frames (F111-F112). The orb, now showing the brand mark, grows from about 10% of frame width (F113) past the frame edges (F121), 8 frames, accelerating; its green fill becomes the ground. The mark then slides left as the wordmark wipes in from behind it (F123-F127, 4 frames), bold italic, about 53% of frame width, white on green.
techniques.routeReason: GrowToScene / caused-morph grows a circle to the frame; the orb render is a still under a circular mask; the wordmark wipe is a clip-path.

techniques.name: Overexposed bloom cut into full-frame screen content
techniques.description: From the wordmark on green, three overexposed mint-white frames (F148-F150, 4.93-5.00 s) replace the frame; the next shot, the live site's 3D illustration at full frame, resolves out of a coarse pixelated blur over F151-F160 (0.33 s) before its headline fades in.
techniques.routeReason: light-burn covers the flash; the pixelated resolve is a scale-down/scale-up of the incoming frame with image-rendering pixelated, stepped per frame.

techniques.name: Full-frame page pulls back onto a monitor on a coloured sweep
techniques.description: The real page is shown full frame for about 0.4 s with its headline fading in (F163-F167), then the frame pulls back onto the monitor screen: the monitor stands on a green studio sweep (#A7E4C0 at top to #053618 on the floor), a brand-colour studio rather than black. Frame to about 47% scale in 0.46 s, decelerating hard.
techniques.routeReason: The monitor on a lit coloured sweep with a screen texture of a real page capture is a Blender plate (blender-plate / studio-product-stage only offers a dark sweep); the page itself must be a real capture under the real-UI rule. The pull-back can be done in Remotion by scaling the capture into the plate's screen corners.

evidence: motion.json s008 camera start 5.59 s span90 0.46 s

techniques.name: Brand-system chips assemble on a gradient and drift out
techniques.description: Green #0DC45E to lime #C5FF93 vertical gradient. A white rectangle grows into a white type chip ('chapter' label, OCR box 47% wide, 17% high, left), five palette dots below it, a round arrow icon at upper right that turns from right to down in one frame (F255-F256), then a dark green pill pops under it with overshoot (F259-F262, 3 frames) and a 3D cursor drifts in. At 9.4 s the whole layout drifts left and slightly down (motion.json s010 x 0.22 frame widths, power2.in) and a 3D fan of cards enters at right.
techniques.routeReason: Chips, dots and icon are divs and SVG; pop with spring() overshoot; the drift is a track on a parent.

techniques.name: Bento assembles around a held hero photo
techniques.description: Two builds. 10.33-13.57 s: a slowly turning 3D fan of glossy cards fills the frame, a right column slides in from the edge in 4 frames (photo tile over a type-specimen tile), and the specimen label is replaced by a lower-case glyph that grows in 4 frames to fill its tile (OCR box 58% of frame height). 16.10-18.63 s: a full-frame people photo snaps in one frame to a card about 63% wide on black; tiles land around it every 1-2 frames with no tween (phone photo, lime tile, colour-bar tile growing segment by segment, orange counter chip), then tall panels slide in from both edges in one frame; 6-8 elements fill the frame by 17.2 s and hold to 18.63 s.
techniques.routeReason: scene-bento-collage covers landing tiles; it lands tiles with motion rather than cutting them on, and has no hero that snaps from full bleed to card, so set its tile entry to a cut and add the snap.

techniques.name: Counters race inside tiles and on a number card
techniques.description: Inside a bento a counter card climbs every frame for about 13 frames (13.57-13.96 s) and a chip from 149+ to 175+ (F506-F518), a percentage from 62.1 to 64.9. At 31.57 s a number card on pale mint (#F9FFF2-ish ground with green glass bars along the bottom) races a figure from 66 to 80 in 9 frames (F947-F955), green, about 73% of frame width with a small grey kicker above and unit line below, holds 10 frames, then pushes in and blurs.
techniques.routeReason: type-number-race and NumberRace / raceValue cover the race; the glass bars are a still render.

techniques.name: Design-canvas placeholder retyped, punched in and built into the live page
techniques.description: White design canvas: bar caret in a thin blue selection box; a three-word line types a word at a time (F564, F570, F574); page parts and multiplayer cursor tags with names arrive; one word is drag-selected and restyled (F586-F611); after a 40-frame hold the line is backspaced by character, 19 characters in 9 frames (F614-F622, about 2.1 a frame), 6 empty frames, then the real headline types a word every 3.4 frames over two lines (F628-F652). From about F648 the frame punches in until the headline overflows both edges (OCR width 0.875), then the nav, a tilted button and 3D currency icons drop into place while the frame drifts left. Hard cut at 23.433 s wide to the finished page in a browser frame on green.
techniques.routeReason: Canvas chrome, selection boxes, cursor tags and typing are Remotion (TypedLine, typingSchedule, Cursor, RegionCamera for the punch-in); the finished page must be a real capture of the site (capture:app).
